topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: I’ve been thinking a lot about what you told me, about how things haven’t been as they seemed with them. It’s strange, finding out the ground you stand on isn’t as solid as you thought. We all have our reasons for the masks we wear, don’t we? Maybe it’s time to talk to them, to understand where this comes from. I just hope we can still see the person we know behind all of this. It’s a tricky path, but I guess that’s what friends are for, right? To walk through the fog together, even when the way isn’t clear.
